What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_MD-*.pod, doc/man3/EVP_DigestInit.pod and providers/implementations/digests/ state no constant-time property.
* `xkcp`: XKCP at d20c8fc: README.markdown and lib/low/KeccakP-1600 state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::keccak_224` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::keccak_384` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::keccak_512` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::keccak_256`: `xkcp` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
